text:
All tests now pass (16 tests, OK). Fixes in `catalog/`:

- `books.py`: `parse_book` now converts the year to `int`.
- `search.py`: it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`, not the nonexistent `catalog.nonexistent`.
- `members.py`: `MAX_BORROWED` changed from 3 to 5.
- `fees.py`: the fee is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`. It was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`.
- `inventory.py`: `recent(n)` now slices `[-n:]`. It was `[-n - 1:]`, which returned one event too many.
- `factory.py`: added the missing `Emma` book to `sample_books()`.
